segments.he: וְדָנִין בְּשֵׁנִי וּבַחֲמִישִׁי – דִּשְׁכִיחִי, דְּאָתוּ לְמִקְרֵא בְּסִיפְרָא.
segments.en: The next ordinance of Ezra is: «And» the courts convene and «judge» every «Monday and Thursday.» The Gemara explains that the reason for this ordinance is «that» many people are «found» in a city on these days, «as they come» from the countryside «for the reading of the» holy «book,» the Torah, which is performed on Mondays and Thursdays, as stated above.

moves.summary: courts sit on reading days when people are present
moves.about: courts sit Monday and Thursday because people are in town for the Torah reading
